baseHeader.methodology: Source-linked original summaries and reference-guided educational reconstructions. Models and motion are unvalidated; artist titles do not independently verify taxonomy. Navigation groups are not a universal kingdom system. Microbial behavior depends on strain and conditions. Expansion entries are individually referenced authored morphology studies; legacy Protista/Monera reporting categories do not replace modern domains. Actual screenshots, software checks and draft status are distinct from independent scientific validation.

before.range: Historical broad Physalia concept; 2025 species split requires photo/occurrence reconciliation.
before.summary: A gas-filled float supports a colony of specialized zooids and long fishing tentacles; it is not a single medusa.

sources.title: Munro et al. · Physalia morphology · 2019
sources.scope: Selected article/index text describes expanded float, muscular crest and ventral zooid organization; later full retrieval returned verification. Uses historical broad Physalia concept; newer 2025 genomic work separates species. No full figure or fitted colony-development review claimed.
sources.type: Morphological source; exact access scope stated

sources.title: Church et al. · Population genomics of a sailing siphonophore · 2025
sources.scope: Selected accessible summary/index: 151 genomes, five lineages and at least four proposed species. Later actual-page retrieval returned verification; full diagnostic figures not inspected. The retained photo and old occurrence concept are not independently reconciled to the new split.

sources.title: Hirose et al. · Optical properties above the waterline · 2025
sources.scope: Actual publisher HTML, selected methods/discussion and complete live-specimen Figure1 inspected. Small Japanese Physalia samples use a historical identification not reconciled to recent splits. Velella figure used as qualitative surface context only. No measured optical constants, microscopic dimensions or RCWA solver imported; microvilli are not enlarged into macroscopic hairs. Figure retained privately, not redistributed.

review.status: Initial individual exterior correction; further realism and independent validation pending
review.remainingInaccuracies: Zooids remain a coarse array, tentacles are too similar and reduced in length, and gas compartments/crest folds are incomplete. No sail-driven drift, wind response or capture mechanism is implemented.
